title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Account Manager
description:
Our client, an iGaming Game provider is seeking an experienced Account Manager based in LATAM, fluent in both Portuguese and English, with a strong background in the iGaming or gambling industry.


This role is ideal for a professional who is passionate about building long-term partner relationships, driving customer engagement, and working closely with internal and external stakeholders. The Account Manager will play a key role in managing client interactions, monitoring partner performance, supporting customer retention, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, results-driven, and open to traveling for business trips and industry events.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for partners by providing ongoing support, answering queries, and resolving account-related issues. Assist with technical inquiries, communicate new features and promotions, and help resolve operational challenges.
  • Drive the successful launch of new game titles by actively promoting upcoming releases and securing optimal placement within partners’ casino lobbies.
  • Monitor partner activity on the platform by analyzing player numbers, betting volumes, gameplay frequency, and performance trends, identifying opportunities for growth or additional support.
  • Focus on sales growth and customer retention through personalized commercial offers, promotional campaigns, and special initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, design, finance, integration management, and technical support to ensure smooth partner operations.
  • Represent the company and present products and services during business trips, conferences, and networking events.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as an Account Manager within the iGaming or gambling industry (experience with casino game providers is an advantage).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain trusted partnerships.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-focused.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Full professional fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel for business meetings and industry events.
  • Proficiency with digital tools and platforms such as HubSpot, Jira, and Confluence.


Salary & Conditions

  • Salary maximum of BRL 15,000 Gross monthly
  • Sales Bonus
  • KPI Bonus
  • Fully Remote as a contractor

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pl/Sr
description:
Somos a maior multinacional brasileira e estamos entre as 100 maiores empresas de TI do mundo.

Estamos presentes em 41 países com +30k colaboradores. A Stefanini tem como principal objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital.

E queremos mais!


Sua missão será atuar no time de Desenvolvedores Stefanini atendendo um dos principais Bancos do Brasil.


Compor o time de desenvolvimento, assumindo itens de trabalho para desenvolvimento a cada Sprint. Realizar as atividades inerentes ao desenvolvimento tais como análise e design, testes e com ênfase em programação. Gerir seu próprio trabalho sinalizando prontamente para a equipe sobre eventuais atrasos.


Responsabilidades e Habilidades:


Compor o time de desenvolvimento, assumindo itens de trabalho para desenvolvimento a cada Sprint. Realizar as atividades inerentes ao desenvolvimento – ênfase em programação - tais como análise e design, testes e programação. Gerir seu próprio trabalho sinalizando prontamente para a equipe sobre eventuais atrasos ou outros impedimentos.


HABILIDADES


Proatividade, capacidade de trabalho em equipe, capacidade de autogerenciamento e tomada de decisão, capacidade de comunicação (capacidade de se expressar oralmente e por escrito com precisão e clareza e de compreender com facilidade mensagens escritas e faladas).


CONHECIMENTO /ATIVIDADES


o) Princípios e práticas de desenvolvimento de software ágil, incluindo o Manifesto Ágil, Scrum, Extreme Programming (XP) e Kanban; p) Análise de requisitos funcionais, não-funcionais e requisitos ágeis; q) Padrões de projeto (enterprise integration patterns, design patterns, SOA, microservices patterns); r) Modelagem de dados relacional; s) Arquitetura de aplicações em três camadas e modelo MVC; t) Interfaces responsivas e aplicações PWA; u) Integração entre sistemas: Mensageria, JMS, Web services, Barramento de serviços (WebSphere Message Broker), REST, EJB 3; v) Javascript, ECMAScript 5 e 6 ou superior, Ajax, JQuery, Angular JS 1.5 ou superior e Bootstrap 3 ou superior, HTML 5, XML, CSS 3 e ASP; w) User Experience (UX) e conceitos de usabilidade;

x) Integração contínua (continuous integration), Jenkins, test-driven development (TDD), acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), especificação por exemplo, refactoring, entrega contínua (continuous delivery); y) Testes de software: teste de unidade, integração, sistema/funcional, aceitação/estória, carga, desempenho, vulnerabilidade, usabilidade, acessibilidade. Automatização de testes funcionais, de unidade e de carga com ferramentas de software. Testes de unidade em Java com a ferramenta JUnit 3 ou superior. Automatização de testes funcionais com a ferramenta Selenium Webdriver 2.4 ou superior e com Protractor. Testes de carga com JMeter 2 ou superior; z) Programação Java para Web: JEE 6 ou superior, JSE 5 ou superior, JSF versões 2.x, JPA 2 e Struts 1.x; aa) Programação de aplicações Java SWING; bb) Análise estática de código com a ferramenta SonarQube; cc) Construção de consultas a bancos de dados em linguagem SQL; dd) Conceitos de controle de versão de código-fonte e uso das ferramentas Clearcase e GIT; ee) Conhecimento na utilização da IDE Eclipse; ff) Configuração de servidores de aplicação; gg) Design de interfaces de programação de aplicações (APIs); hh) Design de aplicações baseadas em microserviços e containers; ii) Arquitetura de aplicações multi-tenancy; jj) Conhecimento em soluções para processamento Batch em Java.


CERTIFICAÇÃO EXIGIDA

Oracle Certified Professional – Java SE Programmer (versão 5 ou superior).


CERTIFICAÇÃO DESEJADA


CSD – Certified Scrum Developer PSD – Professional Scrum Developer

title: Risk Control Specialist (Evening shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform

  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net + Angular Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Guidewire Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal.


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with Guidewire (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter) ;
  • Strong experience in Guidewire Configuration, Integration, and GOSU development ;
  • Solid understanding of Guidewire Studio , Product Model , and Data Model ;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level).
  • Knowledge of Java and REST/SOAP web services is desirable;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional technical and interpersonal skills;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to adapt and evolve in a fast-changing environment.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a culture focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for? Let’s chat!

title: Investment Manager (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Suporte
description:
VAGA – CONFIRMAÇÃO DE PEDIDOS (FULL TIME | HOME OFFICE) - Espanhol Fluente

Somos uma empresa pequena , porém com cultura forte, organização e grande potencial de crescimento . Buscamos uma pessoa comprometida, responsável e focada para atuar na confirmação de pedidos .

Função

Entrar em contato com clientes para:

  • Corrigir endereço incompleto
  • Resolver falta de resposta
  • Ajustar pendências no transporte
  • Solucionar qualquer problema que impeça a entrega do pedido

O trabalho é feito por mensagens e ligações, portanto é obrigatório espanhol fluente, especialmente na fala .

Atenção – leitura obrigatória

O trabalho é HOME OFFICE , porém:

  • Não é trabalho flexível
  • Não é por tarefa
  • Não permite iniciar qualquer hora, parar qualquer hora, exige uma rotina
  • Não permite outros empregos, freelas ou atividades paralelas

Se você acredita que por ser home office pode trabalhar de qualquer forma, em qualquer horário ou conciliando outros trabalhos, este definitivamente não é o lugar para você .

Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Espanhol fluente (fala clara e segura)
  • Disponibilidade FULL TIME
  • Total foco e comprometimento com a empresa
Nossa cultura (INEGOCIÁVEL)
  • Honestidade
  • Respeito
  • Responsabilidade
  • Cumprir exatamente o que foi combinado
Remuneração
  • Salário fixo: R$ 1.900
  • Bônus + metas

Buscamos alguém que queira crescer junto , assumir responsabilidade e fazer parte de um time sério.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

description:

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Responsabilidades

  • Sustentação e evolução de APIs backend
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção usando Python
  • Atuação com Flask e FastAPI
  • Integração com banco de dados SQL Server
  • Uso de SQLAlchemy
  • Correção de bugs e melhorias de performance
  • Apoio técnico ao time e entendimento de regras de negócio


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Python
  • Vivência prática com Flask e FastAPI
  • Experiência com SQLAlchemy
  • Banco de dados SQL Server
  • Experiência em projetos de sustentação


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.


Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Arquiteto (a) Salesforce - Remoto
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Pre-Requisites:


  • Advanced English


  • Required minimum of 10+ years of experience in Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and requirements, and design solutions to meet the needs


  • Architect and design robust and scalable Salesforce Data Cloud solutions based on client requirements and industry best practices.


  • Work with practitioners on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and help build marketing capabilities and assets using data cloud.


  • Understand functional requirements and should be able to develop technical design using standard patterns and be able to communicate the same effectively to the team members.


  • Define and implement data modelling, schema design, and data governance strategies within the Salesforce Data Cloud.


  • Implement seamless integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and third-party systems, such as marketing automation, analytics, and Salesforce CRM


  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


  • Salesforce certifications in Salesforce DataCloud


Roles and Responsibilities:



  • Design and implement scalable data models, build ERD diagrams


  • Build/configure ingestion, data modeling, segmentation and activation within Salesforce Data Cloud and have an understanding of the various cloud platforms that Salesforce data cloud can integrate specifically with Marketing cloud.


  • Design and implement Data 360 data models, including Data Streams, Data Bundles, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), and Data Model Objects (DMOs).


  • Build and maintain data transformations, including Data Mapper recipes, identity resolution rules, and calculated insights.


  • Create scalable segmentation, activation, and unification


  • pipelines to support personalization and analytics use cases.


  • Optimize data ingestion performance with monitoring, validation, and exception handling processes.


  • Implement real-time and batch data synchronization across enterprise systems and Salesforce clouds.


  • Establish best practices for Data Cloud usage, performance tuning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;
  • Analisar Features e User Stories com Product Manager e outras partes interessadas para garantir que atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Participar continuamente das rotinas e cerimônias do time ágil; facilitar as discussões, fornecer esclarecimento, refinar user stories e critérios de aceitação, validar e aceitar entregas de produto;
  • Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;
  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
  • Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
  • Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

  • English

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Frontend Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

O Analista de frontend irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, com um potencial enorme de crescimento.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a arquitetura front-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar, capacitar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;
  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação para front-end Angular – nível avançado;
  • Conceitos de DevOps (Observabilidade, SRE, outros) – nível básico;
  • Esteira (CI/CD) - intermediário;
  • Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;
  • Sistemas distribuídos (contêineres, kubernetes, swarm, outros) – nível básico;
  • Testes unitários, técnicas de manutenibilidade e resolução de vulnerabilidades - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados (SQL, NoSQL) – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software –nível intermediário;


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a arquitetura front-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar, capacitar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;
  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação para front-end Angular – nível avançado;

  • Esteira (CI/CD) - intermediário;
  • Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis
